imagePrompts.blink: Edit image 1 as a game face UV texture patch, NOT a portrait. Image 2 is only the character identity/style reference. Preserve the EXACT pixel layout, rotated face orientation, face outline, ears, hair fragments, skin shading, UV distortion, dimensions and all other content of image 1. Change only the two painted open eyes to softly closed eyes for a normal brief blink. Draw delicate curved dark lashes at exactly the existing eye locations, erase the iris and eye whites into matching eyelid skin; eyebrows and tiny closed mouth must stay unchanged. Do not rotate, straighten, center, beautify, sharpen, reinterpret or add features. Every feature must remain registered to the same coordinates as the input texture. No labels. Warm gentle Nanatau anime cel-painted texture; matching original pale butter yellow #FFFDE7, soft navy #2C3E6B, warm white #FFF8E1 accents. Clean thin-to-medium linework, subtle vulnerable expression, no glossy rendering.

imagePrompts.eyelidSkin: Edit image 1 as a precisely registered game UV texture patch. Source dimensions 550x400. Replace TWO ENTIRE RECTANGULAR AREAS, first x125..250 y40..235, second x340..480 y50..255, with uniform smooth pale warm peach-pink anime eyelid skin matching the cheeks in image 2. Fill ALL pixels inside BOTH rectangles with that skin; remove every dark patch, gold/brown mark, eye, opening, white, fold, teardrop footprint, border, tiny spot and hair color within those rectangles. This is technical padding for UV eye surface islands: all of the rectangle must be seamless matching skin, not only its teardrop-shaped interior. Keep all pixels outside the rectangles unchanged. Preserve exact image layout, dimensions ratio and orientation. Soft flat cel shading only, no highlights, no cast shadows, no gradient into dark brown, no outline or lashes, no iris, no pupil, no drawn features or text. Image 2 is ONLY a color reference for the eyelid skin. Do not create a face or a portrait.
